description: Fix a full body \(\varphi(x,\bar y)\), its finite parameter list and a finite context \(\Gamma\) over those parameters. Supplied HA certificates of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow\varphi(0,\bar y)\) and \(\Gamma^\uparrow,\varphi(e,\bar y)\Rightarrow\varphi(Se,\bar y)\), with protected fresh \(e\), construct an actual intuitionistic HA certificate of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow\forall x\varphi(x,\bar y)\).
